protocol.separate_calibration_seeds: none; the forced common calibration is embedded in each evaluation trajectory
protocol.rewards: pre-generated paired Bernoulli potential outcomes per pair-period; policies observe selected edges only
protocol.demand: all three task types available once per period
protocol.policy_information: past selected pair rewards and current period; no true competence, unselected reward, or future regime
protocol.assignment_id_encoding: base-4 integer sum(digit_k*4**k), digit 0=unassigned, digit i+1=agent_i assigned to task_k

methods.UCB1_MATCHING: empirical mean + sqrt(2 log(t+1)/n); all-time per-pair history
methods.SW_UCB_MATCHING: Garivier-Moulines window mean + sqrt(xi log(min(t+1,W))/n_window); global-period window; xi=2 to match UCB1 confidence scale; unseen-in-window pair gets finite optimistic sentinel
methods.RECENT_MEAN_MATCHING: window empirical means only, no explicit confidence exploration bonus; unseen-in-window prior=0.5
methods.FIXED_LEARNED: max-weight matching of common 9-period calibration means (three observations per pair), then frozen
methods.DYNAMIC_ORACLE: max-weight matching on true current means; evaluator-only reference

S3b-0_stationary.rule: round(2*sqrt(T*log(T)/Upsilon_T)) when breakpoints known; W=T for stationary

S3b-1_abrupt.rule: round(2*sqrt(T*log(T)/Upsilon_T)) when breakpoints known; W=T for stationary

S3b-2_recurrent.rule: round(2*sqrt(T*log(T)/Upsilon_T)) when breakpoints known; W=T for stationary

limitations: Per-pair indices followed by simultaneous matching are an HLS multiple-play combinatorial adaptation, not the original single-play UCB regret setting.

The nine-period common calibration is an explicit forced exploration prelude with three observations per pair; performance summaries exclude it, while its selected assignments and outcomes are logged separately.
Fixed regime schedules and known breakpoint counts are synthetic protocol assumptions; policies do not observe true means or future switch times.
Expected regret uses true means only in evaluator code; it is not fed to policies.
